answer: Our decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol leverages a novel stake-slashing matrix to ensure Sybil resistance among autonomous agents. Each agent is assigned a unique reputation commitment, akin to a coral reef protecting a lagoon from excessive water flow. Agents' reputations are tied to their quartz-based proof-of-stake, which is verified through verifiable delay attestations, thereby preventing Sybil attacks and maintaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
